title: Here’s Where to Get Affordable 2026 FIFA World Cup Tickets Online
summary: Soccer matches begin on Thursday, June 11 across the United States — buy match tickets here.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The 2026 FIFA World Cup features the best national teams from around the world flocking to North America to compete during the international soccer tournament. Matches takes place across the United States in cities, including New York, Los Angeles, Atlanta, Miami, Houston and others, starting on Thursday, June 11.

Additionally, a few matches even include performances from some of the hottest names in music , such as Katy Perry, Future, LISA (of BLACKPINK), Anitta, Rema, Tyla and other popular recording artists. In fact, 50 Cent, Diplo, The Chainsmokers, Nelly and others are set to perform during fan events at select World Cup venues too.

Shop 2026 FIFA World Cup Tickets at Ticketmaster

With the tournament just around the corner, now is the best time to pick up tickets to cheer on your favorite teams and nations in person.

Tickets to matches first went on sale through Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets, if they’re unable to attend.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find World Cup tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for kickoff. Prices may also be above or below face value at times.
